messages:
maria: Quick sync thread / we need alignment on Dedicated GA behavior for reserved pools, soft-eviction, and what telemetry is required to make the rollout safe. I put together an MVP checklist and a few policy questions.

kenji: sounds good, drop the checklist here and we'll map owners.

maria: MVP checklist (high level):
- Reserved-pool admission + contiguous burst windows (5m user-facing)
- Soft-eviction flow: warning, brief grace, deny + structured fallback
- Burst accounting ledger (per-tenant, per-pool) and daily billing export
- Console surfaces: burst balance, active warnings, recent evictions
- Canary plan + acceptance tests

sarah: Runtime caveat: kernel/VPU warmup can add ~80-120ms p95 on cold KV cache. If we allow immediate bursts without prewarm credits the canary p95 numbers will skew. Need to model that in the acceptance tests.

kenji: Telemetry asks from infra: keep burst histograms 30d, store latency percentiles 90d, and provide a daily aggregate export (BigQuery preferred; CSV fallback). Also need a billing-ready snapshot with tenant_id, pool_id, burst_seconds, credits_used.

ralph: ops requirement: every soft-eviction must emit a schema'd event: {tenant_id, pool_id, ts, reason_code, active_requests:int, fallback_model, prewarm_credit_used:float}. ops-bot please register.

ops-bot: /event-schema created: soft_eviction.v1 -> tenant_id,pool_id,ts,reason_code,active_requests:int,fallback_model,prewarm_credit_used:float :white_check_mark:

maria: Policy questions: 1) contiguous 5m windows (user-visible) vs fragmented internal ledger. 2) carryover of unused burst credits between billing cycles for pilot customers?

product_lead: For GA keep it simple: contiguous windows and no carryover. Commercial teams can negotiate carryover in pilot contracts.

kenji: engineering note: contiguous windows simplify admission and cache heuristics but increase chance of short denial periods. We'll need soft-eviction gracebands and warning cadence.

sarah: Soft-eviction algorithm proposal: proportional-fade. When cluster/pool pressure > 90% start emitting warnings, then soft-evict tenants proportional to recent burst consumption weighted by SLA tier. Emit a soft_eviction_warning event 30s before deny with ETA to retry.

maria: Acceptance criteria: warnings must appear in the tenant console within 5s of decision; denied requests return 429 + JSON payload including fallback_model and reason_code; no silent data loss when moving to fallback.

ralph: Ops escape hatch: manual override to lift soft-eviction for a pool for up to 15 minutes. Must create an audit entry with operator, duration, and reason.

devex: Console UX notes: show active warning banners, per-tenant burst timeline (last 7d), and a simple recommended retry backoff snippet. Add a link to support article.

kenji: Metric names proposal (OTLP): dedicated.burst_usage{tenant,pool}, dedicated.queue_length{pool}, dedicated.latency_p95{tenant,pool}, dedicated.evictions_total{tenant,pool,reason}. Keep cardinality in check.

ops-bot: telemetry note: clusters have a soft limit of 10k unique tenant labels before we sample metrics. Instrument aggregations accordingly.

sarah: Autoscale triggers for canary (proposal): primary = sustained queue_length > threshold for 60s, fallback = token_rate delta > 2x baseline for 30s. Add hysteresis: require 3 consecutive windows before scaling to avoid thrash. Canary rollout: 5% reserved-pool traffic for 48h with 4h baseline pre-window.

kenji: Config snippet for autoscale prototype:
```
autoscale:
  queue_threshold: 250
  sustained_window: 60s
  token_rate_multiplier: 2.0
  consecutive_windows: 3
  cooldown: 120s
```

maria: Owners and timeline: telemetry (kenji), autoscale/runtime (sarah), product acceptance & docs (maria), ops escape hatch & alerting (ralph), console work (devex). Target: feature flags + canary gating by end of sprint (2 weeks), GA cut in ~6 weeks if canary passes.

product_lead: Add contingency: if canary shows >5% p95 regression for top 10 tenants, pause and rollback. Also require P0/P1 alerting thresholds defined.

ralph: Proposed alerts: P1 if evictions_rate > 0.5% sustained for 10m on any pool; P2 if telemetry export fails >5m; P0 if admission logic misroutes requests or causes customer-visible data loss.

maria: Final open items before I update the roadmap doc: confirm retention windows (burst hist 30d, latency p50/p95/p99 90d), confirm export format (BigQuery preferred), and decide whether to surface carryover only via contract.

kenji: Confirmed: 30d hist, 90d percentiles. BigQuery export preferred. Carryover = opt-in pilot only.

product_lead: Great. I'll record this in the roadmap doc and schedule the canary start for next Tuesday. Flag any objections here today.

maria: Thanks everyone. I'll open the PR with the checklist + proportional-fade policy text. If no objections, we'll move this into the roadmap.
